collegeFullAddress: Bhaktivedanta Swami Marg, SVKM’s NMIMS (Deemed to be University), Vile Parle (West), Mumbai, Maharashtra 400056
collegeInfo: Mukesh Patel School of Technology Management & Engineering (MPSTME), Mumbai, is a constituent school of NMIMS University and is renowned for blending technology with management, entrepreneurship, and global exposure. The campus boasts excellent infrastructure, industry-driven curriculum, and outstanding placement opportunities with top multinational companies.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Top rankers in NPAT or academic toppers in each branch/year at MPSTME.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Automatically considered at the time of admission and at the end of each year based on academic records.

scholarships.eligibilityCriteria: Reserved categories (SC/ST/OBC/EWS, Minorities, etc.) as per norms.
scholarships.applicationProcess: Apply through national/state government portals after admission.

events.eventFullDescription: Conquer is the annual technical festival at MPSTME, hosting coding challenges, hackathons, robotics, paper presentations, start-up expos, and expert talks. It attracts participation from top institutes across the country.
Sattva is MPSTME’s intercollegiate cultural festival featuring music, dance, literary, fashion, dramatics, and fine arts events, along with celebrity nights and social causes.

collegeName: Mukesh Patel School of Technology Management and Engineering

infrastructure.infraDescription: MPSTME’s campus at Vile Parle provides modern classrooms, advanced labs, research centers, auditorium, Wi-Fi throughout, well-stocked library, multi-cuisine cafeteria, counseling and medical services, gym, sports courts, and residential facilities. The institute offers a vibrant academic and extracurricular experience in the heart of Mumbai.
